tools.name: get_cross_comparison_matrix
tools.title: Get 12-month matrix
tools.description: Return the full 12-month cross-comparison matrix: festival counts (current vs last year), wedding muhurat counts, sale-event counts, weather flag, analyst sentiment label, confidence and festive density.

month.description: Optional 3-letter month key to return a single row.

tools.name: get_month_signals
tools.title: Get month signals
tools.description: Return the secondary-research signal bundle for one calendar month: festive density, festivals with drift, wedding/auspicious muhurat counts (CY vs LY), platform sale windows, academic cycles and the season profile.

month.description: Month as a 3-letter key (Jan, Feb, ... Dec) or full name (January).

tools.name: get_macro_indicators
tools.title: Get macro indicators
tools.description: Return the macro & consumer indicator set with month-on-month comparison (inflation, fuel, UPI volume, card spends, repo rate), plus the electronics import sub-grid and supply-chain watch factors.

query.description: Optional text filter on the indicator label.

tools.name: get_platform_traffic
tools.title: Get platform traffic
tools.description: Return the tracked SimilarWeb-style web traffic snapshot for Indian e-commerce platforms: monthly visits (millions), MoM change %, avg visit duration and bounce rate.

tools.name: search_factor_library
tools.title: Search factor library
tools.description: Search the secondary-indicator reference library (55+ factors) by keyword or category. Each result includes why the factor matters, its source and its update frequency.

query.description: Keyword matched against factor name, rationale and source.

category.description: Category filter, e.g. Calendar, Climate, Macroeconomic, Platform Intel.

tools.name: list_meta_ads
tools.title: List Meta ads
tools.description: List Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ad Library records tracked by this app, newest first. Filter by brand, status, media type or a free-text query on the creative copy.

media_type.description: Media type filter, e.g. image, video, dco.

query.description: Free-text search across creative text and headline.

tools.name: meta_ads_analytics
tools.title: Meta ads analytics
tools.description: Aggregate analytics over the tracked Meta Ad Library records: totals, active share, average days running, and breakdowns by platform, media type, CTA, language, category and advertiser.

brand.description: Restrict the analysis to one brand/advertiser.
